title: Silver Premium Types and Their Premium Ranges
takeaway: The premium for silver varies significantly based on the type of silver purchased.

data.label: Generic silver rounds premium
data.evidence: Generic silver rounds might show a premium of 5 to 8 percent over the spot price.

data.label: American Silver Silver Eagles premium
data.evidence: American Silver Eagles carry a premium, ranging from 15 to 22 percent.

data.label: Ten-ounce bars premium
data.evidence: Ten-ounce bars typically show a premium between 3 and 6 percent.

data.label: Fractional coins premium
data.evidence: Fractional coins, like one-tenth or one-quarter ounce pieces, often have premiums of 25 to 35 percent.
